description: This file defines the AuthorizationCodeRepository class, which implements OAuth2 authorization code management functions such as persisting, revoking, and checking revocation status of authorization codes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth authorization codes, including persisting new codes, revoking codes, and checking revocation status within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Persists a new OAuth authorization code entity into the database.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks an authorization code as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a given authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of an AuthCodeEntity.
